We have been working hard to bring you new features and improve your experience
with the CircleCI VS Code extension. Here is a recap of what's new.

# ✨ New Features

Click on a feature to expand it and view more details.

<div style="margin-left:24px; margin-bottom: 24px">

<!-- ------------------------------------------------------ -->

<details>
    <summary style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; padding-bottom: 10px">
        Multi-project workspace support
    </summary>

<div style="padding-left:25px; margin-left: 5px; border-left:2px solid #007DC5; color: #BBB">
    <div> Starting from v1.14, we introduced support for monitoring multiple CircleCI projects at the same time within the Pipelines Panel. </div>
    </br>
    <div> This means you will no longer need to switch manually between different projects in order to have a complete overview of the workflows that interest you. </div>
    </br>
    <div>This feature works for both single-folder workspaces containing several repos and for <a  href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/multi-root-workspaces">multi-root workspaces</a>.
    </div>

<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; margin-top: 20px">
        <img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/il1yandlcjgk/1G1FF7toduYU5fugC16by7/2151f51f1f0eec013f6b2b28edb99702/multi_project.png" alt="vscode-multi-project" width="340"/>
</div>

<div style="margin-bottom: 20px">

To test the new behavior, simply open a workspace that contains several CircleCI
projects. They will automatically be detected and will populate the Pipelines
Panel. You will also automatically receive notifications for them.

</details>

<!-- ------------------------------------------------------ -->

<details>
    <summary style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; padding-bottom: 10px">
        Ability to mute notifications
    </summary>

<div style="padding-left:25px; margin-left: 5px; border-left:2px solid #007DC5; color: #BBB">
    <div>Workflow status notifications are enabled by default on all your followed pipelines when you first download this extension. </div>
    </br>
    <div> You can now temporarily mute them easily directly through a toggle button in the Pipelines Panel.</div>

<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; margin-top: 20px">
        <img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/il1yandlcjgk/7GFFn1aGUxQIW8aqsUWr9a/e5ebcf9d485c40b15560d80e8140c298/mute_notifications.png" alt="vscode-mute-notifications-from-panel" width="200"/>
</div>

<div>
    This setting is also available in Notifications settings, along with the ability to configure which statuses you want to be notified about.

<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; margin-top: 20px">
        <img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/il1yandlcjgk/4PUW1LkF5BAMI4l2x6AbNF/4c825c6a05b58623848e24ac7eb5f15e/notification_settings.png" alt="vscode-notification-settings" width="460"/>
</div>

</details>

<!-- ------------------------------------------------------ -->
 <details>
    <summary style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; padding-bottom: 10px">
        Access your job logs
    </summary>

<div style="padding-left:25px; margin-left: 5px; border-left:2px solid #007DC5; color: #BBB">
    <div>
    Job logs are now available to browse inside VS Code. 
    </div>

<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; margin-top: 20px">
        <img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/il1yandlcjgk/34DqJHKXzkmUkNBF7Zxa1L/e5c47c4f6fb8de682ecf1cd91a6e7a1b/logs.png" alt="logs" width="600"/>
</div>

<div style="margin-bottom: 20px">

You can access them either from the Pipelines Panel, by clicking on the
<i>eye</i> icon next to a job name, or by clicking on a pop-up notification when
a workflow fails.

 </div>
 <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; margin-top: 20px">
        <img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/il1yandlcjgk/5uZr794zQkSrIvBHyLzq0p/5d392271b86c09d0bc6dad207d2e59e9/notification.png" alt="notification" width="350"/>
</div>
<div>
</details>
<!-- ------------------------------------------------------ -->
<details>
    <summary style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; padding-bottom: 10px">
        Re-run with SSH 
    </summary>
<div style="padding-left:25px; margin-left: 5px; border-left:2px solid #007DC5; color: #BBB">

<div>
    It’s now easy to rerun a job with SSH directly from VS Code. 
    </br>
    You can choose between opening a SSH session <b>in your terminal</b>:
    </div>
<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; margin-top: 20px">
    <img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/il1yandlcjgk/5Q5YsCydCIQqZDS8Dl3ePy/1126453a0088fef4572ca52335384c2e/ssh_terminal.png" alt="ssh_terminal" width="650"/>
</div>
 <div>or in a <b><a htef="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/remote/ssh">remote VS Code window</a></b>:
 </div>
 <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; margin-top: 20px">
    <img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/il1yandlcjgk/PhAxalshH4WakKKx3eJAn/1f3351d12dd426878d1f3544172f496b/ssh_remote_window.png" alt="ssh_remote_window" width="600"/>
</div>
</div>
</details>
<!-- ------------------------------------------------------ -->
<details>
    <summary style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; padding-bottom: 10px">
        Validate your Config 
     </summary>
<div>
<div style="padding-left:25px; margin-left: 5px; border-left:2px solid #007DC5; color: #BBB">

<div>
Checking the validity of your config file has become much easier. We introduced commands to:
<ul style="margin-top:10px">
<li>Validate your config file </li>
<li>Validate your config file against your organization policy</li>
<li>Preview the expanded version of your config file</li>
</ul>
</fib>
<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; margin-top: 20px">
    <img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/il1yandlcjgk/5yiRslRg3IeP5ruvgjO8Lr/dfed757d78f5c552020d8a705b04afb2/config_commands.png" alt="config_commands" width="400"/>
</div>
When you are editing your config file, you can access these commands through the contextual menu on the top right of your tab:
<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; margin-top: 20px">
    <img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/il1yandlcjgk/1tqlNTjZ7DpoBOI8GqVWIw/9229ebb119e5a426f752db290ee4f596/config_button.png" alt="config_button" width="500"/>
</div>
</div>
</details>

<!-- ------------------------------------------------------ -->

<details>
    <summary style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; padding-bottom: 10px">
        Update your orbs with a quick fix 
    </summary>
<div style="padding-left:25px; margin-left: 5px; border-left:2px solid #007DC5; color: #BBB">

<div>You will no longer need to search the docs for the latest version of your orb. Find this information
directly in your config file, and update your orbs easily with one click.
</div>
<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; margin-top: 20px">
    <img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/il1yandlcjgk/1Ryih6X2B7aJt0NHEXFdla/69f014169704894e75eec02b811929ad/orb_quick_fix.png" alt="orb_quick_fix" max-width="100%" width="400"/>
</div>
</div>
</details>
<!-- ------------------------------------------------------ -->
<details>
    <summary style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; padding-bottom: 10px">
        Navigate configs through breadcrumb path and document outline
    </summary>
<div style="padding-left:25px; margin-left: 5px; border-left:2px solid #007DC5; color: #BBB">
<div>

View your current location in the config file, and navigate quickly between your
commands, jobs and workflows, thanks to the navigation bar at the top of your
file.

</div>
<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; margin-top: 20px">
    <img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/il1yandlcjgk/3m98roOJuEorA3Ra2Vrkom/508b79cda69f70b9a976b5953208c580/breadcrumbs.png" alt="breadcrumbs" max-width="100%" width="500"/>
</div>
<div>
You can also view the structure of your file in the <b>outline panel</b>, in your files explorer.
</div>
<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; margin-top: 20px">
    <img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/il1yandlcjgk/48QsIUectFUF9SarWTF1xs/9d4a05d1f9bdad34822e4d3677d3e305/outline.png" alt="outline" max-width="100%" width="300"/>
</div>
</div>
</details>
<!-- ------------------------------------------------------ -->
<details>
    <summary style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; padding-bottom: 10px">
        View your test results
    </summary>
<div style="padding-left:25px; margin-left: 5px; border-left:2px solid #007DC5; color: #BBB">

If you have configured your tests to have reports on CircleCI, through the
`store_test_results` step, then you can view your test results in the Pipelines
Panel.

<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px; margin-top: 20px">
    <img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/il1yandlcjgk/4Gw9UM2DIcUn6R3A9vUIeW/c920311db6122a3cfd7609f01405edf8/tests.png" alt="tests" max-width="100%" width="400"/>
</div>
</div>
</details>

<!-- ------------------------------------------------------ -->

</div>

# 🚧 Fixes and improvements

- <div><b>We adopted Websockets instead of polling</b></br>This improves the reactiveness of the Pipelines Panel, and the overall performance of the extension.<div>
- <b>We now persist project settings by Workspace</b>
- <b>We improved the authentication experience</b>, and addressed issues that
  caused some users to be logged out unexpectedly
- <b>We fixed all known false errors and warnings in the Config Helper</b>
